adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real issue in the diff. Looking at addGuests.handler.ts, the code at line 92 performs `prisma.booking.update()` to add attendees to the database, then later at line 165 calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` to sync with external calendars. If the calendar update fails, the database already has the new attendees committed, but the calendar doesn't. On retry, the `uniqueGuests` filter at lines 68-72 will exclude these emails since they're already in `booking.attendees`, making it impossible to retry the calendar sync. This is a legitimate data consistency bug where database and calendar can get out of sync with no recovery path.
